title: Jehoshaphat Appoints Judges and Urges Justice
description: After receiving a warning from the seer Jehu, King Jehoshaphat travels through the land from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim to bring the people back to the Lord. He appoints judges in the fortified cities of Judah and in Jerusalem, instructing them to judge with fear of the Lord, without partiality or bribery. The high priest Amariah is to lead in matters concerning the Lord, and Zebadiah the prince in matters concerning the king.
